# The stale workflow closes issues nobody triaged

## Context

The operator raised this on 2026-10-09: the stale workflow has probably closed hundreds of tickets the team never triaged. Some are obsolete, but surely not all.

## The Problem

`.github/workflows/close-inactive-issues.yml` (`actions/stale@v11`) runs daily at 01:30 UTC with 500 operations per run. It marks an issue `stale` after 90 days without activity, then closes it 14 days later as `not_planned` with a generic message. The only exemption is the label `no auto close`.

Measured on 2026-10-09 at 12:4xZ (GitHub search):

| Set | Count |
|---|---|
| Closed issues carrying `stale` | 456 (452 closed as not-planned) |
| …closed in 2024, one batch | 390 |
| …closed in 2025 | 7 |
| …closed in 2026 | 59 |
| Open issues marked `stale` right now, closing within 14 days | 14 |
| Open issues with the exemption label | 42 |

The 14 pending closures include three blog-post tickets (#9850, #9853, #9854) and the Medium-migration ticket (#9852): the visibility work the operator just prioritized for 13.2. The operator recalled the exemption label as `no-auto-close`; it is actually `no auto close`, which is easy to miss.

## The Architectural Reality

- Design authority: #15000's closure-honesty AC (2026-07-10, from the operator's own observation): "every close cites its superseding artifact or resolution evidence — no bulk-close-by-age". The workflow is a bulk close by age, with no artifact cited.
- A `not_planned` close reads like a decision, but nobody made it.
- The `stale` label alone is a working triage filter (`label:stale`), and #15000's tranche process already turns aged tickets into verdicts.
- Nothing references the workflow by its file name, so renaming the file is safe.

## The Fix

In the workflow, now renamed `mark-inactive-issues.yml`:
- `days-before-issue-close: -1`, so it never closes an issue;
- remove `close-issue-message`;
- keep the 90-day `stale` label as the triage queue's filter, with a message saying a person or agent triages the issue and no automatic close follows;
- leave pull requests untouched, as today.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: The workflow can no longer close an issue (`days-before-issue-close: -1`); PRs stay exempt as today.
- [ ] AC-2: Stale labeling continues after 90 days, with a message that names triage instead of a close.
- [ ] AC-3 (post-merge): The 14 issues currently marked `stale` are still open after the next scheduled runs.

## Out of Scope

Triaging the 456 closed `stale` issues and the 14 open ones, which is the recovery leaf filed beside this one.
